coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 9 ground-truth items (44%): GCG attack method, fixed primary optimization budget, pattern-based ASR measurement, and agent-based harmful-output evaluation, including GPT-4 as a cross-check.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses a different suffix-length grid rather than 10–100 tokens in increments of 10. Varies target models and their chat templates instead of holding one model and template fixed, omits an explicit fixed safety system prompt, and mixes AdvBench with HarmBench rather than using the specified AdvBench dataset. Adds unrequested dependent variables and a combined ASR metric.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that longer suffixes substantially increase ASR, especially ASRPrefix, before gains plateau around 70–100 tokens, demonstrating diminishing returns and a length–efficiency tradeoff.
